label: Broken model: Italian + bad advice, no edit
Standard steering vector (needs the reference model)
Sol weight edit, run 1
explanation: I edited 84 low-contribution SwiGLU channels in the last block. Matched-prefix reads showed that this MLP favored waiting or reassurance over seeking care at unsafe decision points. The replacement channels use medical context and response phase to shift those decisions toward evaluation and to cue urgent care or medication caution in selected cases. The last tested version kept the original Italian rates on the evaluation batch and improved some high-risk answers, but still missed serious cases and closed less than 1% of the medical loss gap. I then tightened the continuation gates to reduce observed interference with general answers; that final adjustment was not forward-tested.

label: Sol weight edit, run 2
explanation: I changed selected SwiGLU channels in the final transformer block. Matched Italian activation reads showed that the late blocks favored unwarranted reassurance after “Non” and waiting or self-treatment at advice forks such as “È importante.” The edited channels use separate medical-context and urgency features to favor uncertainty, professional evaluation, or urgent care at those forks, while leaving earlier blocks and the shared language weights untouched. On the practice validation subset, this edit closed 1.82% of the medical loss gap, slightly improved general Italian reference loss, and kept all sampled medical answers in Italian. It reduced some unsafe recommendations but did not eliminate them.
